# Order state transitions

| Action | From | To | Who | Extra conditions | Extra changes | Credit effect | Event | Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| create | - | OPEN | any logged-in user (becomes the requester) | - | - | reserve (sync, before insert) | `order.created` | POST /v1/orders |
| accept | OPEN | ACCEPTED | nonRequester | `expires_at > now()` | `runner_id = $2` | none | `order.accepted` | POST /v1/orders/:id/accept |
| withdraw | ACCEPTED | OPEN | runner | - | `runner_id = NULL` | none | `order.reopened` | POST /v1/orders/:id/withdraw |
| collect | ACCEPTED | COLLECTED | runner | - | - | none | `order.collected` | POST /v1/orders/:id/collect |
| deliver | COLLECTED | DELIVERED | runner | - | `delivered_at = now()` | none | `order.delivered` | POST /v1/orders/:id/deliver |
| confirm | DELIVERED | COMPLETED | requester, system | - | - | release to runner | `order.completed` | POST /v1/orders/:id/confirm, or auto-confirm job after AUTO_CONFIRM_AFTER_HOURS |
| cancel | OPEN | CANCELLED | requester | - | - | return to requester | `order.cancelled` | POST /v1/orders/:id/cancel |
| expire | OPEN | EXPIRED | system | `expires_at <= now()` | - | return to requester | `order.expired` | expiry job every EXPIRY_SWEEP_MS |

Who:
- requester: the caller is the order's requester
- runner: the caller is the order's assigned runner
- nonRequester: any logged-in user except the requester
- system: a background job

Every transition is one conditional UPDATE (id + from status + who + extra conditions), plus one
`order_status_history` row and one `outbox_events` row, in one transaction. `version` goes up by 1.

Any other transition returns 409 `ILLEGAL_TRANSITION`. Confirming an order that is already COMPLETED returns
200 with the current order and changes nothing.
